observedCiFailure.exception: HTTP/1.1 header parser received no bytes; Windows connection aborted on write

investigation.note: The intermittent CI abort was not reproduced in these repeats; the deterministic late-body test exposes the same unsafe connection-persistence boundary. No packet trace proves they have exactly one cause.

red.assertion: 403 response to headers-only POST did not advertise Connection: close

fix: Consume currently available request content before committing JSON response headers. Explicitly advertise Connection: close if content is incomplete; no blocking drain or automatic command retry.
